notice: Mixed provenance. Entries tagged verification_status 'verified' or 'source_listed' are drawn from official public listings on the date in last_verified and should still be confirmed before a resident relies on them. Entries with synthetic=true are clearly-labelled demonstration data and are NOT real services. 'historical'/'expired' entries are shown only to demonstrate how closed or time-limited programmes are withheld from automatic recommendation.

services.name: Bolton Employment Hub
services.description: Bolton Council's employment support service for residents. Help with job searching, applications and interview preparation, building a CV, access to training and skills, and support returning to work after a break or changing sector.
notes: Service relocated to the One Stop Shop in 2026; confirm the current location when booking.

services.name: National Careers Service
services.description: Free, impartial careers information, advice and guidance for adults in England. Includes a skills assessment, help choosing a direction, and support with CVs and job applications by phone, webchat or online.

eligibility.label: Aged 13 or over (full guidance for adults 18+)

notes: National service available to Bolton residents online and by phone.

services.name: Jobcentre Plus (DWP), Bolton
services.description: Department for Work and Pensions support for people claiming Universal Credit or looking for work, including a work coach, help with job searching, and access to other DWP programmes.
notes: Confirm your local Bolton jobcentre and appointment arrangements via GOV.UK.

services.name: Greater Manchester WorkWell (WorkWell Bolton)
services.description: A health-and-work support pilot for Greater Manchester residents who face a health condition or disability that puts their work at risk, or who are recently out of work with a health condition. Work and health coaches give one-to-one support to stay in or return to work.

eligibility.label: Have a health condition or disability affecting work
Joined through a referral — participants are identified and invited by health or employment providers

referral_requirements: Participants are identified and invited by providers; it is not a direct self-referral route. Ask a work coach or an adviser whether a referral is possible.
notes: Time-limited pilot funded to 31 March 2027 — confirm it is still open before relying on it.
Voluntary and referral/invite-based, so it is offered only as 'ask about a referral', never as an automatic sign-up.

services.name: Access to Work (DWP)
services.description: A government grant that can pay for practical support at work if you have a physical or mental health condition or disability — for example specialist equipment, support workers, or help getting to and from work. It does not affect other benefits.

eligibility.label: Have a health condition or disability affecting work
In paid work or about to start paid work or self-employment

params.note: Also covers a confirmed job start.

notes: Applies once a job or start date is in place; a resident still job-hunting can note it for later.

services.name: Citizens Advice Bury & Bolton
services.description: Free, confidential and impartial advice on money and debt, benefits and welfare rights, employment and housing rights, and consumer issues. Available by drop-in, phone, email and an out-of-hours service.

eligibility.label: Live in the Bolton or Bury area

notes: Independent charity, separate from Bolton Council.

services.name: Bolton College — adult courses and skills
services.description: Adult education and skills courses in Bolton, including English and maths (functional skills), vocational qualifications, and routes into further training. Some courses are free depending on circumstances.

eligibility.label: Typically aged 19 or over for adult courses

notes: Course availability and any fee or free-course eligibility change each term — confirm with the college.

services.name: Learn My Way — free online digital skills
services.description: Free online courses that build basic digital skills — using a device, getting online, staying safe, and using online services. Useful if applying for jobs online feels difficult.
notes: Online and open to anyone; for face-to-face help, ask about a local digital drop-in in Bolton.

services.name: Kickstart Scheme (closed)
services.description: A former government scheme that funded short job placements for young people on Universal Credit. It is included here only to demonstrate how closed programmes are handled — it is no longer available.

eligibility.label: Was for 16 to 24 year olds on Universal Credit

notes: Closed to new applications in 2021 and ended in 2022.
Shown only to demonstrate that expired programmes are never auto-recommended.

services.name: Bolton Wellbeing at Work (demonstration)
services.description: DEMONSTRATION SERVICE (not real). Stands in for a local wellbeing-at-work service offering confidence building and help managing stress while looking for or staying in work. Used to show how wellbeing support would appear.
notes: Demonstration only — confirm a real equivalent with Bolton Council before signposting a resident.

services.name: Bolton Community Connectors (demonstration)
services.description: DEMONSTRATION SERVICE (not real). Stands in for a community hub offering volunteering, social connection and informal routes back towards work. Used to show how community support would appear.
notes: Demonstration only — confirm a real equivalent with Bolton Council before signposting a resident.
